targetTest: launches the mapper once with --restricted in the staging copy, activates mode fast, completeness partial and restricted true, and leaves the checkout byte-identical
expected: onboard --restricted <repo> launches one `claude -p /gsd-map-codebase --fast --restricted ...` in the staging copy, activates a record with mapping fast, completeness partial and restricted true, status shows `partial (restricted)`, `--restricted --mode full` exits 64, and the unenforced-host refusal names --restricted
actual: onboard --restricted is not a flag: the command exits 64 (`exactly one repository path is required`, because the unknown flag swallows the repository path) where 0 was planned; --restricted --mode full exits 3 where 64 was planned; the plain onboarding blocks enforcement_failure with `host unavailable reports enforcement none; containment cannot be guaranteed` and no mention of --restricted
semanticAssessment: All four tests ran to their planned assertions against the real CLI, a real composed profile and a fake claude, and failed on exit-code and message assertions for the missing restricted onboarding, not on syntax, load or fixture faults.
